content.short: Edge City runs pop-up villages bringing together builders at the frontier of technology and society.
content.description: Edge City organises pop-up villages, month-long gatherings where people working on frontier technology, science and society live and build together in one place. Its Edge City Patagonia event runs a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory. It grew out of the pop-up city movement that includes Zuzalu, which treats in-person community as infrastructure for new ideas.
content.meta: Edge City runs pop-up villages for frontier builders, with an Edge City Patagonia mini app in World App.
